chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Fudhayl narrated from Saʿd ibn ʿUmar al-Jallab, who said:

Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام said: “Any woman who spends the night while her husband is displeased with her regarding a rightful matter, no salat (prayer) from her is accepted until he becomes pleased with her.”

key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman, specifically a wife in this context
key_terms.فِي حَقٍّ: regarding a rightful claim or legitimate right

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about a wife whose husband is angry with her over a rightful matter?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a wife spends the night while her husband is displeased with her concerning a legitimate right, her salat (prayer) is not accepted until he is pleased with her. It underscores the seriousness of fulfilling spousal rights and the connection between worship and the rights owed to others.
